children.source: w => { defer w.write_string("D"); w.write_string("B"); scheduler.pause(); w.write_string("C"); if stop { return }; scheduler.pause(); w.write_string("E") }
w => { defer scheduler.emit(w, "D"); errdefer scheduler.emit(w, "E"); w.write_string("B"); w.write_string(scheduler.read(fail)); w.write_string("C") }
w => { defer { w.write_string("D"); ignore(scheduler.read(true)) }; scheduler.pause(); w.write_string("B"); return }
w => { try { w.write_string(scheduler.read(fail)) } catch { Failed(_) => { scheduler.emit(w, "caught"); return } }; w.write_string("C") }
w => { defer w.write_string("D"); w.write_string("B"); if pause_first { scheduler.pause() }; fail_sync(); w.write_string("unreachable") }
w => { w <+ "B\{inner => { return scheduler.emit(inner, "C") }}D"; return scheduler.emit(w, "E") }
w => { for attempt in 0..<3 { try { w.write_string(scheduler.read(attempt == 0)); return } catch { Failed(_) => w.write_string("retry") } }; w.write_string("unreachable") }
